title: FinDialogLens：多方对话事件抽取识别金融聊天室遗漏交易
summary: 该研究将金融聊天室中遗漏交易识别建模为多方对话事件抽取任务，提出混合LLM流水线FinDialogLens，利用微调分类器作为推理脚手架，检测RFQ触发与价格/交易结果，并用难度感知路由器在规则引擎与LLM间分配请求，降低85%的LLM调用，每天节省超300美元。
summary_en: This work casts missed-trade identification in financial chatrooms as event extraction over multi-party dialogue and presents FinDialogLens, a hybrid LLM pipeline where fine-tuned classifiers act as inference-time scaffolds to detect RFQ triggers and price/trade outcomes. A difficulty-aware router cuts LLM calls by 85% while saving over $300/day at scale.
